# Classes the EZ Scanner OpenUI report actually renders.
#
# Captured by walking every element under #root of /report.html (a completed
# 1200-address scan, 58 clean, FA + dark theme, `embed=1`) and collecting
# classList, cross-checked against the DOM order: the report's
# `root = Card([header, verdict, kpis, gates, chartHeader, chart, topHeader,
# topTable, failsHeader, failsTable])` renders exactly these blocks, so no other
# OpenUI component can appear in the report iframe.
#
# Blank lines and `#` comments are ignored. Consumed by
# scripts/prune-openui-css.mjs --capture and test/openui-css.test.ts: every class
# listed here must still have rules after the prune.
#
# Regenerate the capture with, in the report iframe:
#   [...document.querySelectorAll('#root *')].flatMap(el => [...el.classList]).filter((c, i, a) => a.indexOf(c) === i).sort()

openui-card
